thread:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: multiple alerts firing - service=inference-prefix-cache, region=eu-west, severity=high. Alert group: prefix_cache_miss_surge. Page policy triggered: oncall-eng.
Riley Cooper: I’m on it, picking up the page. suspecting a cache regeneration storm after yesterday's deploy.
Maria Chen: thanks Riley. quick ask: customer-facing errors? any 5xx spike?
Riley Cooper: 5xxs are flat. It's token-level latency spikes and a lot of eviction churn. P95 for small requests went from 120ms -> 430ms across multiple pods.
Alex Rivera: saw the incidentbot. tagging infra runbook and metrics — https://redwood.internal/dashboards/prefix-cache-eu-west
Devon Patel: if it's eviction churn, batching backpressure might be saturating mem-cpu. can you paste the alert window?
Riley Cooper: alert details:
```
alert: prefix_cache_miss_surge
expr: increase(prefix_cache_miss_total[5m]) > 500
for: 1m
labels: {severity="high", owner="eng-runtime"}
```
Riley Cooper: right now it's firing every 30s across 6 nodes.
Maria Chen: initial mitigation: increase `cache_retention_ms` on the affected group by 2x to reduce churn, and lower batch size temporarily.
Alex Rivera: can you show the current deploy hash? if this started after release we should rollback.
Riley Cooper: latest deploy is `commit: 9f3b2a` (rolled out 02:14 UTC). I don't see rollback requests in deploy-bot.
Devon Patel: I'm going to put a temporary squelch rule on the alert to reduce paging noise while we triage. Will annotate and then create permanent tuning if needed.
Devon Patel: applying squelch: `/incident squelch prefix_cache_miss_surge 30m reason="eviction churn suspected"` — will also add annotation to runbook.
sre-bot: Squelch applied by Devon Patel for 30m. Annotation ID: annot-2026-03-15-01
Maria Chen: thanks. Riley — try bumping cache_retention on one canary ASG to validate.
Riley Cooper: doing it now on canary-pool-3. command:
```
kubectl patch cm runtime-config -n inference -p '{"data":{"cache_retention_ms":"120000"}}'
```
Riley Cooper: canary results: eviction rate down ~60% after 2 mins. latency p95 dropped to ~150ms.
Alex Rivera: great. let's make a conservative alert change: increase the threshold to 800 over 5m and add `annotation: runbook_link` so oncall has quick context.
Devon Patel: agreed. proposed rule patch (for PR):
```
- expr: increase(prefix_cache_miss_total[5m]) > 500
+ expr: increase(prefix_cache_miss_total[5m]) > 800
  for: 1m
  labels: {severity="high", owner="eng-runtime"}
  annotations: {runbook="https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefix-cache-evictions", mitigations="bump_cache_retention, reduce_batch_size"}
```
Maria Chen: also add `noisy=true` label for ephemeral surges so we can route to paging-squelch automatically.
Riley Cooper: I'll open the PR against `terraform/alerts` with both the threshold bump and the runbook link. PR link when ready.
sre-bot: Incident note: customer impact assessed as: latency increase for small inference calls in EU-WEST, no customer-visible errors. Impact severity: P2.
Alex Rivera: handoff — my shift starts in 20m, I'll take ownership post-handoff to follow through on the alert tuning + PR reviews.
Devon Patel: action items: 1) Riley - PR with threshold & annotations (due immediate). 2) Maria - update runbook with the recent mitigation steps and add the new dashboard panel. 3) Alex - review PR and coordinate permanent tuning with runtime team. 4) Devon - follow up on squelch expiration.
Riley Cooper: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/terraform/alerts/pulls/342 (includes change + changelog entry). marking owner=Riley.
Maria Chen: updating runbook now: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefix-cache-evictions — adding section "post-incident: threshold normalization" and the incident timeline.
Alex Rivera: once runbook updated, please add me as reviewer on the runbook doc. I'll also update the dashboard: add a 5m rolling anomaly band and a panel that correlates eviction_rate with p95 latency.
Devon Patel: squelch expires in 28m. if the PR merges before that, we'll update the alerting infra to include the `noisy=true` label so incidentbot can avoid paging for known bursts.
Riley Cooper: merging PR now. terraform plan looks clean. applying in staging first.
sre-bot: Deploybot: terraform apply for alerts module started by Riley Cooper.
Riley Cooper: staging applied, will monitor for 10m then apply in prod during low-traffic window (in 35m). tagging this thread for postmortem notes.
Maria Chen: adding follow-up: runbook owner change proposal -> move ownership to eng-runtime on the runbook header, add contact `@eng-runtime-oncall` and include the dashboard link.
Alex Rivera: thanks all. I'll take the after-action and ensure this gets a short postmortem + runbook PR for ownership and the new annotation examples.
sre-bot: Incident closed: alerts normalized, mitigations verified. Closing incident for prefix_cache_miss_surge. Reference: incident-2026-03-15-01
Riley Cooper: closing thread. good job team. :thumbsup:
